body:
First of all apologies, it's not surprising we are expecting a few regressions as the 3D FTI is completely replaced and will need this bit of field testing.

Top tip is when getting issues is to drop the physics tick rate, when I drop the tick rate down to 10tps, I can see that sometimes when the ball is re-added, the previous xforms don't seem to be being pumped as it is always being interpolated from the initial position, which is strange. Just debugging now to find out why. 👍 

UPDATE:
It's a flag that's got out of sync in `SceneTreeFTI`, my bad, just working out why this is happening.
Ah got it. On `NOTIFICATION_EXIT_TREE` I'm removing the node from the `SceneTreeFTI` but I'm not resetting all the flags. When it re-enters the tree a flag that is still left set thinks it is already on the lists for interpolation.

Will fix. 👍
